messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy started for tenant 'Cedar Health' on dedicated pool cedar-vpc-1

deploy-bot: artifact=sha:abcdef1234, rollout=5% traffic, config=pinned=false

incident-bot: Paging @janet (oncall) — elevated 5xx rate observed in cedar-vpc-1 canary (5m window). Alert: cedar-canary-5xx-rate

janet (oncall): On it. Linking logs and metrics. @miguel can you check runtime logs for that shard?

miguel (eng-runtime): pulling logs now. seeing tokenization OOMs + KV-cache evictions around 12:08 UTC. stacktraces mainly from model init path. suspect quantization variant mismatch with the pinned runtime kernels.

natalie (sre): cpu/gpu utilization looks normal, memory spikes on node cedar-vpc-1-03. Network ok. Can you paste the exact failing request samples?

miguel (eng-runtime): pasting anonymized samples and trace ids:
```
TRACE 0x7f3ab12 - prompt_id=... - model_init_error: RuntimeKernelMismatch
```

janet (oncall): Thanks. This looks like the canary artifact (abcdef1234) introduced an incompatible op set with our compiled kernels for that dedicated pool. We should revert the canary to the previous pinned artifact to stop customer impact. @tara (tsm-customer-success) can you confirm we should proceed with immediate rollback and notify Cedar Health? This will cause a brief disconnect for canary traffic but should keep production steady.

tara (tsm-customer-success): I need to notify the Cedar SRE lead and PM. Looping in @pm-lee and support. Cedar prefers immediate revert for canaries. They asked to be notified before rollback — I've messaged them; waiting for thumbs up.

support-lucas: Cedar confirmed, ok to revert the canary. They want post-rollback validation before resuming rollouts.

janet (oncall): okay authorization present. Miguel — run the revert procedure to previous artifact sha: abcdef0000 and pin it for cedar-vpc-1. Steps:
1) pin previous artifact
2) trigger canary abort and rollback for dedicated pool
3) monitor healthchecks and traces

miguel (eng-runtime): executing step 1:
```
rdrctl artifact pin --tenant cedar-health --pool cedar-vpc-1 --sha abcdef0000
```

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Pin created: cedar-vpc-1 -> abcdef0000 by miguel at 2026-03-12T12:15:20Z

miguel (eng-runtime): starting canary rollback now. invoking revert playbook: `playbooks/revert_canary_dedicated.sh cedar-vpc-1 abcdef1234 abcdef0000`

deploy-bot: rollback job queued. job_id=rb-20260312-8743

natalie (sre): monitoring health endpoints. Initial spike in 5xxs is tapering. kube-probes for pods on node cedar-vpc-1-03 are recovering.

janet (oncall): good. keep the rollback pinned (no auto-redeploy). Also add temporary autoscaling cap to avoid noisy neighbor CPU contention: `kubectl patch ...` (handled by eng-infra if needed)

miguel (eng-runtime): rollback complete on all canary nodes. all pods restarted with abcdef0000. confirming model kernel compatibility check passed.

deploy-bot: rollback job rb-20260312-8743 finished: SUCCESS. artifacts now at abcdef0000 on cedar-vpc-1

natalie (sre): external health checks green for 3 consecutive cycles. 5xx rate back to baseline.

pm-lee: Notifying Cedar PM: cedar confirmed they see normal behavior in their quick tests. Thank you for the fast action.

tara (tsm-customer-success): Customer asks: can we add a hold on auto-rollouts until eng-runtime validates the build matrix for dedicated pools? They want assurance before resuming.

janet (oncall): Agreed. miguel, create a ticket to add preflight compatibility checks for dedicated VPC pools, and also add an emergency canary abort if 5%+ errors in 5m.

miguel (eng-runtime): creating ticket now. TICKET-ENG-5721: "Add preflight kernel compatibility & canary abort thresholds for dedicated pools". assigned to eng-runtime, ETA 2w.

natalie (sre): will add temporary alert runbook note and mark this incident as customer-impacting for cedar-health.

janet (oncall): handoff: I'm wrapping up oncall time in 8m, @natalie you'll take next watch. please keep an eye for regressions. I'll follow-up in postmortem.

natalie (sre): copy, taking watch. will watch dashboards and confirm 30m stability.

pm-lee: thanks team. Cedar requests a short RCA and timeline for patch—I'll collate notes and follow up with them.

janet (oncall): closing thread here. Incident mitigated by pinned rollback. Postmortem owner: miguel. Action items: TICKET-ENG-5721 (eng-runtime), runbook update (sre), customer notification (pm-lee).

deploy-bot: incident documented with id INC-20260312-cedar-canary-revert

janet (oncall): closing at 2026-03-12T12:39:59Z :white_check_mark:
